meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, LSP, and language-native tooling. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库九大维度,输出带优先级的技术债报告。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想动手重构前先摸清代码库里哪些地方最该修。
copy.tagline_en: Audit code on 9 dimensions and get a prioritized tech-debt report.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what to fix before refactoring.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你的代码库，从架构、类型、测试、安全等 9 个维度查找技术债，每条发现都标注 file:line:col，最后在仓库根目录写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md，含严重级别、工时估算和按优先级排序的修复清单。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审，或提到「tech debt」「code health」等关键词时触发。超过 5 万行的代码库会拆给并行子代理分区审计。

say.text: 帮我审计这个仓库的技术债，生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say.note: 在仓库根目录输出审计报告

say.text: 看看 src/ 目录的代码健康度，按严重程度列出来

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase for technical debt across 9 dimensions (architecture, types, tests, security, etc.), citing file:line:col for every finding, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md in the repo root with severity, hour estimates, and a prioritized fix list.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, or architecture review, or mention keywords like "tech debt" or "code health". Codebases over 50k LOC are split across parallel sub-agents.

say_en.text: Audit this repo's tech debt and generate TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md
say_en.note: Writes the report in the repo root

say_en.text: Check src/ code health and list issues by severity
Find quick wins I can fix in under 30 minutes
